reserveReview.rationale: Genuine new whole-direct-claim reserve review on 2026-10-22; the prior review was 2026-10-20 at height 62034705. Current primary architecture states that USDN represents M locked on Ethereum via M0 Portal/Wormhole NTT, not independent direct Treasury holdings by Noble. At noble-1 height 62161692, hash 13E890E9BDC2A38B345E8E15EB78EE713F3098F3CB2A25415D312E9ECEE1490B, timestamp 2026-10-22T13:12:02.028878537Z, stats, index and bank-supply requests all returned the requested height through grpc-metadata-x-cosmos-block-height. total_principal is 1315252291142, index is 1.098390419505000000 and uusdn supply is 1444660515822 raw units. Principal times index is 1444660515822.373775524710 raw units, whose floor equals current supply exactly. Explicit-height header hashes and timestamps matched before and after the reads; observation ended 2026-10-22T13:12:15.925Z. This corroborates the complete local M-denominated claim, not independent Ethereum escrow sufficiency, bridge coverage, final redemption liquidity or M0 collateral assurance. The single direct reserve remains 100% m-m0, with parent risks and unknown liquidity retained.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Direct USDN custody is M locked on Ethereum through M0's Portal and Wormhole NTT contracts. Under D08, parent minter SPV custody and insolvency safeguards remain upstream facts reviewed on m-m0; they do not establish direct Noble-holder protections. Current Noble documentation does not establish product-level legal segregation, insolvency priority or reuse rights. The custodyModel scalar describes this direct on-chain escrow, not the underlying Treasury custodians.
